patthana15.61:1.1: sukhasahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sukhasahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. sukhasahagataṃ kusalañca na sukhasahagataṃ kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.61:2.1: sukhasahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sukhasahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na sukhasahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi, (abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇimeva.)
